title: Effects of Alloying Elements and Mechanical Alloying on Characteristics of WVTaTiCr Refractory High-Entropy Alloys
process_description: prepared by mechanical alloying of elemental powders (W, V, Ta, Ti, Cr) at 300 rpm for 16 h with a ball-to-powder ratio of 10:1, followed by uniaxial pressing at 210 kg/cm² and sintering at 1450°C for 2 h in Ar atmosphere with a heating rate of 2°C/min from 950°C to 1450°C.
